verdict.rationale: Rev AI's own feature docs state that words or terms outside the average English dictionary can be submitted as custom vocabulary to improve ASR accuracy, which is the capability this story asks for. The evidence is a single sentence, so how the feature works in practice is not shown. Missing for 10: details on how custom vocabulary is submitted (API parameters, list limits, boost weighting), confirmation it works for both async and streaming APIs, and independent or hands-on corroboration of accuracy gains.
